integrity: The proof reduces the least-row question at the minimal admissible row to the central binomial coefficient and then applies Kummer's exact carry theorem. An independent standard-library checker in this package verifies the digit equivalence and enumeration on a deterministic finite grid; the infinite statement is established by the symbolic proof.
limitations: The theorem classifies only the absolute-minimum branch \(T_p(m)=2m\); it relies on the published sharp maximum \(r_p(m)\) and does not determine least extremal rows outside this branch. One supporting 2026 paper was inspectable only through its abstract plus the direct source's theorem-level comparison, leaving residual bibliographic risk.
title: Base-\(p\) digit classification of absolute-minimum restricted-GCD extremal rows
